name: datetime-input
blurb: Smart date/time input with natural language parsing and visual calendar/time picker.
description: SmartDatetimeInput component that accepts natural language input (via chrono-node) on one side and a calendar/time picker popover on the other. Configurable to show calendar, time picker, or both via showCalendar and showTimePicker props.
use_when: Users need flexible date/time entry with both natural language ('tomorrow at 2pm') and visual selection.
avoid_when: Minimal UI contexts where space is extremely constrained — the component needs room for input + picker buttons.
a11y: Input is keyboard-accessible with focus states. Calendar and time picker use standard a11y patterns.
